headline: TRITN surged 50.00% intraday on low volume while FTREIT recorded a 29.1σ volume spike amid a 5.43% price gain.
market_take: Construction and REIT stocks dominated today with extreme price moves and volume spikes. Food stocks faced pressure, highlighted by XBIO's 16.67% drop and AQUA's 10.00% rise intraday. Several high‑impact filings, notably connected‑transaction disclosures for STPI and PRIN, add a governance focus across sectors.

sector_notes.note: TRITN jumped 50.00% intraday (vol×0.22) and EMC opened with a 50.00% gap before rebounding 100.00% intraday; STPI filed a high‑priority connected‑transaction opinion.
XBIO fell 16.67% intraday (vol×2.16) while AQUA rose 10.00% intraday; ITC and TU posted volume spikes of 3.1σ and 3.6σ respectively, and TFMAMA disclosed a capital change and new honorary advisor.
FTREIT surged 5.43% on a 29.1σ volume spike; M‑STOR dropped 14.61% and IMPACT fell 5.15%; FTREIT also filed a medium‑priority asset‑investment disposal.
PRECHA rose 15.25% (vol×1.47) and RML gained 11.11% on strong volume (vol×4.08); PRIN reported a high‑priority connected‑transaction and AP filed a medium‑priority acquisition/disposal.
PPPM opened with a 5.71% gap down and posted a 5‑day decline of 13.20%.
SCC announced a merger and partnership in Jin Zhong Fa Paper Industrial.
